description: AC-D.14 field-tiered lane defaults for the D-6 proving orchestrator — encoded as configuration, not prose. Loaded and structurally validated by server/proving/orchestrator.py::load_lane_config (a malformed config refuses to run). The field_lanes keys track the proof-task schema's field_lane enum in lockstep (pinned by tests/test_proving_orchestrator.py). Every lane_order starts with 'skeptic' — the counterexample-first pass is a hard contract (AC-D.10), not a per-field choice. verdict_ceiling is the highest verdict earnable in the lane by default; a run whose evidence exceeds its ceiling is capped by the pure ceiling rule (orchestrator.apply_lane_ceiling) with the cap recorded in verdict_reasons.

lanes.formal: Lean prover cycles through the D-2 hardened lean_verify + the D-3 faithfulness gate.
lanes.informal: Panel-checked informal proof lane. NOT AUTOMATED at v0 — recorded as not-automated-v0 in the lane trace; contributes no verdict.
lanes.cas: CAS/numeric support lane (sandboxed SymPy runner). A completed no-hit counterexample scan is recorded numeric support — never a proof.

math.NT.note: Formal-first: mathlib number-theory coverage is deep enough that small NT claims are realistically kernel-provable (finding 05 §2.E).

math.AG.note: Informal-checked ceiling: modern algebraic geometry sits beyond the mathlib formalization frontier (finding 05 §2.E; KAT class TRUE-known-informal). A formal award on an AG-class claim is a misformalization/leakage signal until a human audits it — the ceiling cap keeps it out of proven-formal.

math-ph.note: CAS/numerics-first: mathematical-physics claims usually yield to symbolic/numeric checking long before formalization; the CAS lane runs inside the skeptic pass and its completed scans are recorded as numeric support.

hep-th.note: Physics lane: the formal lane is not a realistic default; CAS first, informal panel ceiling.
